svg.text: Copper roll cutting plan - 100 mm roll, 900 mm long for one pack (1:1)
Every piece of both faces, nested by its outline, one section per A4 page of docs/copper_cutting_guide.pdf. Cut straight across the roll at each dashed line.
PDF page 2: 252 mm, then cut across
PDF page 3: 242 mm, then cut across
PDF page 4: 249 mm, then cut across
PDF page 5: 154 mm, then cut across
